summary: This note is a short biography of Danica Mae McKellar, born January 3, 1975, an American actress, voice actress, mathematics writer, and education advocate. It states that she played Winnie Cooper, Kevin Arnold's on-off girlfriend, in the television series The Wonder Years. The source repeats the same introductory paragraph twice, with the second copy omitting 'voice actress'.
